export.title: Client data held by {{salon}}
export.intro: This document lists the data the salon keeps about the client in GuGu Studio: profile, bookings, internal notes and the Zalo conversation.
export.disclaimer: GuGu Studio is designed to support salons in answering personal-data requests. This is not legal advice.

client.hint: Owner only. Use when a client asks to see or delete their data. Every action is logged.
client.eraseBody: The profile, tags, internal notes and Zalo conversation content are deleted. Past bookings stay for your reports but show as “Deleted customer”, without name, phone or email. Upcoming bookings are cancelled. This cannot be undone.
client.eraseHint: Export first if the client also wants a copy.
client.erased: Client data deleted: {{bookings}} bookings anonymised, {{cancelled}} upcoming bookings cancelled.

salon.title: Data and privacy
salon.body: Export all of your salon's client data (JSON and CSV). Files can be downloaded only here, for 24 hours; no link is sent by email.
salon.requested: Creating the export. This page updates by itself.
salon.retention: The notification send log is deleted after 12 months. Raw Zalo events are deleted after 30 days. Expired sessions and sign-in links are cleaned up automatically.
salon.disclaimer: GuGu Studio is designed to support salons in handling clients' personal-data requests. This is not legal advice.
